# Horse Racing Companion

> An independent iPhone app for Del Mar race days. One pick per race (Win,
> Show, or a three-horse Trifecta box), every horse's estimated win chance, a
> confidence level, and the reasons. Picks are saved about two minutes before
> post and shown beside the official result. No pick when Del Mar history is
> too thin, odds cannot be confirmed by the cutoff, or a late scratch leaves no
> safe replacement. The app does not accept wagering funds, place or send
> wagers, or connect to a betting operator. Not affiliated with, endorsed by,
> or sponsored by Del Mar Thoroughbred Club.

Key facts:
- Platform: iPhone (iOS). Available in the US App Store since September 1, 2026:
  https://apps.apple.com/us/app/horse-racing-companion/id6802113749
- Screens: Races (the day's card, post times, surface, distance, next race
  first, other race days selectable), Race (the pick, confidence, reasons, and
  every horse with jockey, trainer, weight, current odds or morning line, and
  estimated win chance; scratched horses crossed out; a rough estimated return
  on the $2 minimum bet from current odds), Results (per race day: picks that
  matched, did not match, or had no pick, each beside the official top
  finishers), How It Works (the method), and Settings (free days, season pass,
  Restore Purchases, optional reminders about an hour before first post).
- No account or sign-in. A random installation ID, shown in Settings, tracks
  free days and the season pass.
- The first three racing days are free and include every pick on that day's
  card. A free day is used when the user taps "Use a Free Day" and confirms.
  After that, the app offers one non-renewing season pass for the rest of the
  current Del Mar season. The app and App Store show the exact price and access
  end date before purchase. The pass is not a deposit, wagering balance,
  credit, virtual currency, or payment method for a wager. Race cards, odds,
  results, past picks, and How It Works are free without a pass.
- The analysis uses public information only: morning-line and current odds
  and past Del Mar results (each horse's Del Mar record, trainer, jockey, that
  trainer-jockey pairing, and post-position performance by surface and
  distance). Scratched horses are removed first. No profit is guaranteed and
  pick confidence (Low, Medium, High) is how steady the pick is, not a win
  probability.
- Pick types: Win (the horse finishes first), Show (the horse finishes in the
  top three), or a three-horse Trifecta box (the three horses fill the top
  three in any order). The clearest picks carry a "Strongest pick" badge. A
  close race still gets a pick, marked Low confidence. No pick is shown only
  for insufficient Del Mar history, odds that cannot be confirmed before the
  cutoff, or a late scratch with no safe replacement.
- There is no adjustable stake control, teller wording, betting-window
  instruction, wagering account, deposit flow, operator connection, or wager
  execution or transmission.
- Live picks normally begin about two hours before the day's first race. The
  app shows that day's expected opening time. Before then, "Live Picks Open
  Later" is a normal scheduled state; "Live Updates Delayed" is reserved for
  missing fresh data after the window opens. A pick is "Early" until about two
  minutes before post, then "Final".
- Live record: Across ten tracked cards from August 20 through September 4, 2026, 31 of 72 final pre-race picks matched their published result type, a live pick-match rate of 43.1%. The app made no pick in 16 of 88 settled races. Every counted pick was saved before the official finish was known. All cards used public-card v0.4: ticket-policy v0.4 matched 23 of 56 picks (41.1%) across eight cards; ticket-policy v0.5 matched 8 of 16 picks (50.0%) on September 3–4. A match means the saved pick satisfied its published Win, Place, Show, or multi-horse finish condition. This small sample does not establish profitability or a betting edge. September 5 races are not included.
- Why it was built: the developer, Brett Pollak, found the betting window the
  hardest part of a Del Mar race day and saw most attendees choosing horses
  by paddock impressions, colors, or lucky numbers. The app applies the same
  public data and the same rules to every race.
- Responsible wagering: for adults of legal wagering age where wagering is
  lawful. Problem-gambling help: https://www.ncpgambling.org/
